# Center for Educational Equity | Teachers College, Columbia University

> A research and advocacy center at Teachers College focused on advancing educational equity through democratic governance, civic engagement, and data-driven school improvement initiatives.

The Center for Educational Equity conducts research and develops programs addressing systemic inequities in public education, with particular focus on school governance, student and parent voice, and civic learning. The center partners with schools and districts across New York State and nationally to implement evidence-based approaches to educational equity.

## Key Topics

- Educational Equity
- School Governance
- Civic Education
- Democratic Participation
- School Boards
- Student Voice
- Parent Engagement
- School Finance
- Program Evaluation
- Data-Driven Governance
- Democratic Governance
- Public Education Policy
- Education Policy
- New York State
- Participatory Budgeting

## Core Programs & Initiatives

- [What We Do](https://cee.tc.columbia.edu/what-we-do): Overview of Center for Educational Equity programs and initiatives
- [Deepening Democracy in Schools](https://cee.tc.columbia.edu/what-we-do/deepening-democracy-in-schools): Democracy in Schools program featuring civic education initiatives
- [Data-Driven School Governance](https://cee.tc.columbia.edu/what-we-do/data-driven-school-governance): Data-driven governance projects including Dewey Data and LDAP
- [EdDemTech](https://cee.tc.columbia.edu/what-we-do/eddemtech): EdDemTech platform for participatory budgeting and school governance
- [Empirical Storytelling (Program Evaluation)](https://cee.tc.columbia.edu/what-we-do/empirical-storytelling-program-evaluation): Empirical Storytelling program evaluation methodology and OUR VOICES

## Research & Labs

- [S-BYE Lab (School Board and Youth Engagement Lab)](https://cee.tc.columbia.edu/s-bye-lab): School Board and Youth Engagement Lab research and RA opportunities
- [Publications & Media](https://cee.tc.columbia.edu/publications--media): Publications, research, and media from Center for Educational Equity
